titulo: This Vampire Fish Is Older Than the Dinosaurs
tema: Why the lamprey, a jawless and boneless 'vampire fish' that starts life blind in the mud, is older than the dinosaurs
estilo_visual: award-winning photorealistic underwater nature photography, natural light, clear water, shallow depth of field, sharp focus

audio.como_ler: picos_cortados.trechos > 0 = distorção; silencios = buraco de 0,7 s ou mais no meio do vídeo; saltos_volume = volume muda 6 LU ou mais em 1 s; voz_abafada = trecho em que a música (ou ruído) preenche os vãos da fala (heurística: confirme pela transcrição)

cenas.narracao: This fish has no jaws, no bones, and it outlived the dinosaurs.
cenas.quadro: Close view of only the middle section of a very long smooth wet eel body, thick as a garden hose, mottled olive-brown skin with no scales, no head visible, no tail visible, no fins, the body enters and leaves the frame, lying in loose loops over smooth rounded river stones in clear shallow sunlit water
cenas.movimento: slow push-in, water ripples softly over the stones

cenas.narracao: It is called the lamprey. Its mouth is a round sucker, lined with rings of teeth.
cenas.quadro: Macro underwater photograph of a wet living gray-pink fleshy mouth disc pressed against aquarium glass, irregular natural skin folds and slime, hundreds of sharp yellow-brown hooked teeth in uneven concentric rings around a dark round throat, no eyes, no face, dark blurred water behind
cenas.movimento: very slow push-in, tiny particles drift in the water

cenas.narracao: Many adults latch onto living fish and slowly drink their blood. No wonder people call them vampire fish.
cenas.quadro: Close view of the silver scaled flank of a large lake trout in clear blue-green lake water, a small round red wound mark on its side, soft light from above, only the side of the trout visible, no head visible
cenas.movimento: gentle drift alongside, light shimmers on the water

cenas.narracao: But they do not start as vampires. Baby lampreys are blind, toothless, and hide in the mud.
cenas.quadro: Soft brown river mud under clear calm water, small round burrow holes in the mud, fine sand grains, no animals visible
cenas.movimento: fine silt drifts slowly over the mud

cenas.narracao: Buried in a riverbed, they filter tiny bits of food from the water for several years.
cenas.quadro: The muddy bed of a calm shallow stream underwater at dawn, rounded pebbles, fallen leaves, small round burrow holes in the mud, clear water above, no animals visible
cenas.movimento: water ripples gently over the streambed

cenas.narracao: Then their bodies rebuild themselves. Eyes appear, teeth grow, and they swim away as hunters.
cenas.quadro: Close view of only the middle section of a very long smooth wet eel body, thick as a garden hose, silvery-gray skin with no scales, no head visible, no tail visible, no fins, the body enters and leaves the frame, gliding just above a sandy riverbed in clear water, sunlight dappling the sand
cenas.movimento: slow gentle pan following the lamprey, sand grains drift

cenas.narracao: Lampreys already swam in ancient seas. That was long before the first dinosaur walked the Earth.
cenas.quadro: A deep ancient sea floor, a large weathered gray limestone rock covered in moss, sun rays filtering down through blue water, no animals visible
cenas.movimento: light rays shimmer slowly through the water

cenas.narracao: Their skeleton is not bone. It is soft cartilage, the same flexible stuff inside your nose.
cenas.quadro: Seen from directly above, only the middle section of a very long smooth wet eel body, thick as a garden hose, mottled olive-brown skin with no scales, no head visible, no tail visible, no fins, the body enters and leaves the frame, bent in a gentle S curve on dark wet river stones in clear shallow water
cenas.movimento: the body sways softly, water ripples

cenas.narracao: No jaws, no bones, a childhood in the mud. And this fish still outlived the dinosaurs.
cenas.quadro: Close view of only the middle section of a very long smooth wet eel body, thick as a garden hose, mottled olive-brown skin with no scales, no head visible, no tail visible, no fins, the body enters and leaves the frame, lying in loose loops over smooth rounded river stones in clear shallow water at golden hour, warm light
cenas.movimento: slow push-in, water ripples softly over the stones
